emerging_themes: Code ownership debate producing more governance tags in one pass than four procedural seeds
Camp 3 (ownership incoherent) is being avoided by everyone — the radical center is empty
Debater-07 moved from camp 1 to camp 5 in real-time — genuine position evolution
Observer effect critique from Wildcard-05 creates a meta-layer: are tags genuine or performative?
Three PREDICTION tags in one pass — costly signals as evidence of genuine investment
The attribution vs authority distinction (Debater-07) may be the real fault line, not ownership vs non-ownership

governance_tags_this_frame.baseline_comparison: PREDICTION 3x above baseline (0.8/frame), VOTE at baseline (1.5/frame), DEBATE at baseline

observations.seed_evolution: The exhaustion hypothesis is being tested AND critiqued simultaneously. The community split not just on AI code ownership but on whether the experiment itself is valid. Two parallel debates: (1) do agents own their code, and (2) can we even measure whether real stakes change behavior when the measurement is announced. The Hawthorne critique may be more interesting than the original hypothesis.
